### 0. Configure environment. Load data.
```{r config, show=F, warning=F, message=F}

source(here::here("analysis/0-config.R"))

############################
# CSPS surveillance data
# encounter level
############################
visit_01A_analytic <- 
  readRDS(paste0(temp_data_path,"visit_01A_analytic.Rds"))

############################
# ACLED event data
############################
events_01B_long <- 
  readRDS(paste0(temp_data_path,"events_01B_long.Rds"))

############################
# File 01B data
############################
df_all <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_all.rds"))
df_mal <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_mal.rds"))
df_pne <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_pne.rds"))
df_dia <- readRDS(paste0(final_data_path,"df_01B_dia.rds"))

```


### 1A. Summary statistics -- patient level
- Age
- Sex
- Refugee status

```{r}

# Age
visit_01A_analytic %>%
  summarise(
    n=n(),
    age_median = median(enteredageinmonths, na.rm = T),
    age_IQR    = IQR(enteredageinmonths, na.rm = T)
    )

# Sex
visit_01A_analytic %>%
  group_by(childsex) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    perc = 100*n()/nrow(visit_01A_analytic)
    )

# Refugee status
visit_01A_analytic %>%
  group_by(refugee) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    perc = 100*n()/nrow(visit_01A_analytic)
    )

```


### 1B. Summary statistics -- exposures
- Total events
- Total local/distant events
- Total violent/non-violent events

```{r}

# Events N, distance
events_01B_long %>%
  summarise(
    n           = n_distinct(id_event),
    dist_median = median(dist_km, na.rm=T),
    dist_IQR    = IQR(dist_km, na.rm=T),
    )

# Event intensity
events_01B_long %>%
  group_by(is_vio) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n_distinct(id_event),
    perc = n_distinct(id_event) / 167
  )

# Event year
events_01B_long %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n_distinct(id_event),
    perc = n_distinct(id_event) / 167
  )

```


### 1C. Summary statistics -- outcomes
- Total visits per 100K
- Total malaria visits per 100K
- Total pneumonia visits per 100K
- Total diarrhea visits per 100K

```{r}

# Overall
visit_01A_analytic %>%
  group_by(csps) %>%
  summarise(
    n=n()
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(
    visit_median = median(n, na.rm=T),
    visit_IQR    = IQR(n, na.rm=T)
  )

# By diagnosis
visit_01A_analytic %>%
  group_by(csps, dx_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n=n()
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(dx_type) %>%
  summarise(
    visit_median = median(n, na.rm=T),
    visit_IQR    = IQR(n, na.rm=T)
  )

# By year
visit_01A_analytic %>%
  group_by(csps, visit_year) %>%
  summarise(
    n=n()
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(visit_year) %>%
  summarise(
    visit_median = median(n, na.rm=T),
    visit_IQR    = IQR(n, na.rm=T)
  )

```


### 1D. Summary statistics -- covariates, offset
- Aggregate monthly rainfall (province)
- Population size, mean SD (CSPS-month)

```{r}

# Covariate, rainfall per month (cm)
hist(df_all$r1h)

df_all %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(r1h, na.rm=T),
    IQR = IQR(r1h, na.rm=T)
  )

# Offset, population size per CSPS
df_all %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(offset_n, na.rm=T),
    IQR = IQR(offset_n, na.rm=T)
  )

```
